column10: step_action

column2: Toolshop - Account - Overview - Account page shows section navigation
column3: Verify that the account overview links to all account sections.
column10: Log in as a customer and navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/account.
column11: My account page displays navigation to Favorites, Profile, Invoices and Messages.

column2: Toolshop - Account - Profile - Updating profile fields persists
column3: Verify that profile edits are saved and survive a reload.
column10: Log in and open Account > Profile.
column11: Profile form is displayed with the current values.

column10: Change the phone and street values and click "Update Profile".
Reload the profile page.

column2: Toolshop - Account - Profile - Required-field validation on update
column3: Verify that clearing a mandatory profile field blocks saving.
column10: Log in and open the profile page.
Clear a required field (e.g. first name) and click "Update Profile".
column11: A validation message is displayed and the profile is not saved with the empty value.

column2: Toolshop - Account - Password - Customer changes the password and logs in with the new one
column3: Verify the change-password flow end to end including old-password invalidation.
column10: Create a fresh user via the API, log in and open the profile page.
Fill the current password and a valid new password (twice), then submit.
Log out and log in with the NEW password.
Log out and try to log in with the OLD password.
column11: Login is rejected with the generic error.

column2: Toolshop - Account - Password - Wrong current password is rejected
column3: Verify that the password cannot be changed without knowing the current one.
column10: Log in and open the password section on the profile page.
Enter a wrong current password with a valid new password, then submit.
column11: An error is displayed and the password is not changed.

column2: Toolshop - Account - Favorites - Favorite can be removed from the favorites page
column3: Verify that deleting a favorite removes it permanently.
column10: Log in and add a product to favorites from its detail page.
Open Account > Favorites.
Click the delete button on the favorite.
column11: The product disappears from the list and does not reappear after a reload.

column2: Toolshop - Account - Invoices - Invoice PDF can be downloaded after async generation
column3: Verify the asynchronous invoice PDF download flow.
column10: Complete an order and open Account > Invoices.
Open the invoice and request the PDF download.
column11: The download becomes available once processing finishes (async status) and a PDF file is received.

column2: Toolshop - Account - Messages - Contact messages sent while logged in are listed in the account
column3: Verify that account messages reflect submitted contact forms.
column10: Log in and send a valid contact message from the Contact page.
Open Account > Messages.
column11: The sent message is listed with its subject and status.

column2: Toolshop - Account - Security - TOTP two-factor setup is available on the profile
column3: Verify that the profile offers TOTP 2FA setup and accepts a valid code.
column10: Log in and open Account > Profile.
column11: The "Set up Two-Factor Authentication" section displays a TOTP secret and a code field.

column10: Generate a TOTP code from the displayed secret (authenticator app or library), enter it and click Verify.
column11: 2FA is enabled for the account (verification succeeds).

column2: Toolshop - Account - Session - Expired session redirects to login
column3: Verify that account pages require re-authentication after the token expires (~5 minutes).
column10: Log in as a customer.
Wait for the access token to expire (about 5 minutes of inactivity) and open an account page.
column11: The session is dropped: the user is taken away from the account page and the navigation shows "Sign in" again (re-authentication required).
